title: Wing's Contracts
description: A system to incentivize automation via randomly-generated contracts.
body:
![A Contract Portal with a diamond floating above, sitting in a forest.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/aeLVgBaJ/images/c63f7b0a9069f83cbc39d9f574b072408a4a8cbd.png)
## About
Wing's Contracts adds a highly configurable contract system to incentivize players to automate things. Contracts are:
- randomly generated using a pool of possible inputs and rewards provided via datapacks.
- can be for specific items, sets of items, tags of items, or even for items that match custom conditions.
- are fulfilled by placing the contract into a Contract Portal and dropping items in.

Additionally, Bound Contracts can be used to securely create contracts between players. **The default configuration for Wing's Contracts is intended for casual singleplayer**. For guidance on configuring the mod and suggested configurations for more technical servers, see [the wiki](https://github.com/benjaminiserman/WingsContracts/wiki). Wing's Contracts can also be configured to reward (optionally denominated) item currencies if provided by your server or modpack.

## Mod Compatibility
Wing's Contracts has first-class support for [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and [CC: Tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked). If Create is installed, ponders are provided for all blocks added by this mod. Wing's Contracts additionally has support for the following mods via its default contract pool:
- [Applied Energistics 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2)
- [Botania](https://modrinth.com/mod/botania)
- [Brewin' and Chewin'](https://modrinth.com/mod/brewin-and-chewin)
- [Create Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons)
- [Create Crafts & Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/createaddition)
- [Create Deco](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-deco)
- [Create: Enchantment Industry](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantment-industry)
- [Create: Garnished](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-garnished) 
- [Create: The Factory Must Grow](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-tfmg)
- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)
- [Fruit's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/fruits-delight)
- [Hexerei](https://modrinth.com/mod/hexerei)
- [Immersive Engineering](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersiveengineering)

## FAQ
### How do I get started with Wing's Contracts?
See: [Getting Started](https://github.com/benjaminiserman/WingsContracts/wiki/Getting-Started). Also check out the in-game ponders if you have Create installed.
### How do I configure this mod?
See: [How to Configure Wing's Contracts](https://github.com/benjaminiserman/WingsContracts/wiki/How-to-Configure-Wing%27s-Contracts)
### This mod seems overpowered!
Try configuring it! The default configuration is not intended for advanced players. Check out [Suggested Configurations](https://github.com/benjaminiserman/WingsContracts/wiki/Suggested-Configurations) to find something a little more your speed.
### Why are there no contracts for animal products?
It feels wrong to me to incentivize players to replicate the intense and extensive suffering of real-world factory-farmed animals in Minecraft. If you want contracts for doing so, you'll have to add them yourself via datapacks. Alternatively, compatibility with [Vegan Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/vegan-delight) adds some contracts to the contract pool for animal products that have alternatives provided by that mod.
